entries.name: S-400-inspired
entries.balance: Broad abstract coverage; costly deployment, finite ammunition, radar/supply support and relocation delay.

entries.name: Akash-inspired
entries.balance: Protect local objectives; trades coverage for support cost and mobility.

entries.name: Rafale-inspired
entries.balance: Flexible mission choice; endurance, readiness and ammunition constrain persistence.

entries.name: Su-30MKI-inspired
entries.balance: A heavier air role balanced by higher support demand; no guaranteed superiority.

entries.name: Tejas-inspired
entries.balance: A lighter air role with limited endurance and payload in gameplay.

entries.name: BrahMos-inspired
entries.balance: A platform-inspired strike role requested in the expanded brief; costly finite shots against eligible fictional assets.

entries.name: JF-17-inspired
entries.balance: Flexible opposing air role; fictional balance values and support needs.

entries.name: F-16-inspired
entries.balance: Opposing fighter role with finite mission resources.

entries.name: J-10C-inspired
entries.balance: Alternative opposing air role; no real-world performance ranking implied.

entries.name: HQ-9/P-inspired
entries.balance: Opposing defensive role balanced through supply, ammunition and readiness.

entries.name: Reconnaissance drone
entries.balance: Reveals contacts; trades combat power for information.

entries.name: Strike drone
entries.balance: Adds a drone attack role with finite capacity and counter-drone interaction.

entries.name: Counter-drone system
entries.balance: Specialized protection with resource and coverage limits.

entries.name: Radar vehicle

entries.name: Armour

entries.name: Infantry

entries.name: Fleet
